text: Canonical layout points: A4 ≈595×842pt, US Letter 612×792pt, LinkedIn square 1080×1080pt, LinkedIn wide 1200×628pt, custom 6×4in = 432×288pt. Author only against layout bounds; do not use mm for child p()/s(); do not treat renderer pixels as scene coordinates.
Preferred generated structure: page … / artboard al(v,g(18),pad(36)) p(0,0) s(fill,fill) fill($surface.page) clip(true) / card al(v,…) …
note: Recommends an auto-layout root with a card — a structure components.md says is not required ("no full-page skeleton is binding", "not mandatory cards").

text: Do not put background(...) on a page creation line. Use the root artboard/frame fill(...) for first-pass backgrounds … Do not create a separate top-level bg rectangle for the artboard background.
Use parent-relative layout before absolute placement: fill, hug, al()/pad()/g()/wrap(true); fixed point values only where the visual size is intentional.

Avoid: A4 children authored as 210×297; hardcoded page-sized root dims; card s(170,210) with descendants s(400,…); loose top-level bg/card/header nodes exceeding the artboard; switching px→mm to make a preview smaller. If one parent is resized, inspect and update the affected descendants.
